# ymfm

Source: MAME's `3rdparty/ymfm` (Aaron Giles, BSD 3-Clause).

This subset contains the generic FM engine, YM2151 OPM, and YM3438/OPN
implementations used by the System 16A and System 18 audio runtimes. The OPN
subset includes the shared ADPCM/SSG source files required to build YMFM's
chip library. The corresponding license is in `LICENSE`.
